source_of_truth.cross_check: Read-only cross-check of all 24 runs (rows, case cohorts, recomputed-vs-stored quality) on 2026-10-02: see agent/reports/historical-artifact-check.json (private; not part of this published package).
source_of_truth.files: Archived copies are byte-identical snapshots of the still-retained private working files at their original relative paths (sha256 recorded below); the published comparison/ files are the retained original harness (sha256 recorded in 'published_files', cross-checked against agent/reports/historical-source-baseline.json). They are snapshots of retained working files, NOT of run-time git commits; no run-time commit of the shared comparison code is pinned by any existing artifact.
source_of_truth.metrics: Summary metrics are copied verbatim from the stored comparison/results/<run>/summary.json (quality denominators exclude error rows, per the historical metric definition). No metrics were recomputed or modified here.
